records.label: Market Setup v2
records.title: Market Setup v2 classification method
method_notes: Market Setup v2 combines Macro Regime and Market Confirmation through an approved setup matrix
Macro Regime is selected from the ISM survey synthesis direction
Market Confirmation aggregates equity trend, credit, and volatility confirmation tests and the M2 liquidity offset
Market Setup v2 is executed by the deterministic Market Setup v2 engine; the assistant may explain it but never change it
records.explanation: Market Setup v2 is the approved deterministic method that classifies the current market setup. The assistant explains the method and its results but has no authority to change them.

records.label: Portfolio Posture
records.title: Portfolio posture contract method
method_notes: Portfolio posture is derived from the approved posture matrix keyed by the Market Setup code
Posture codes include risk_on, mild_risk_on, neutral_selective, defensive, mild_risk_off, and insufficient_data
Each posture contract embeds net exposure, gross exposure, implementation, broad beta, positioning, and avoid guidance
Portfolio posture is executed by the deterministic Market Setup v2 engine; the assistant may explain the selected posture contract but never change it
records.explanation: Portfolio posture translates the current Market Setup classification into the approved posture contract. It is a deterministic engine output and never invents allocation percentages or instruments.

records.label: ISM Survey Synthesis
records.title: ISM Survey Synthesis direction method
method_notes: ISM Survey Synthesis combines ISM Manufacturing and ISM Services survey signals into an economic direction and growth momentum
Economic direction values are aligned_expansion, aligned_contraction, aligned_neutral, and divergent
Growth momentum values are rising, falling, flat, and mixed
Expected GDP direction values include rising, slowing, falling, improving, rebound_risk, and stable
The synthesis is executed by the deterministic engine; the assistant may explain it but never change it
records.explanation: ISM Survey Synthesis is the sole macro regime selector input. It combines the two ISM surveys into a single survey growth direction.

records.label: VIX Confirmation Method
records.title: VIX confirmation v2 threshold method
method_notes: VIX confirmation v2 classifies VIX as stress at or above the approved 20.0 threshold and normal below it
It participates in Market Confirmation as one confirmation test
The assistant may explain the method but never change it
records.explanation: VIX confirmation is a level threshold test executed by the deterministic engine. The assistant may explain the approved method but has no authority to change it.

records.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI Method
records.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI diffusion index method
method_notes: The PMI level and its direction are separate classification dimensions
The level and direction are classified by the deterministic engine and the assistant must never infer one from the other
The assistant may explain the method but never change it
records.explanation: ISM Manufacturing PMI is a monthly diffusion index computed as the share reporting better plus half the share reporting the same. Its level and its direction are separate classifications executed by the deterministic engine.

records.label: M2 Liquidity Offset Method
records.title: M2 money supply liquidity offset method
method_notes: The M2 liquidity offset status is expanding or shock
The offset participates in Market Confirmation as an offset and is not counted in the confirmation test count
The assistant may explain the method but never change it
records.explanation: M2 money supply is a liquidity offset that can support a directional confirmation. Its offset status is executed by the deterministic engine and never changes the confirmation test count.

records.label: S&P 500 Market Phase Method
records.title: S&P 500 market phase method
method_notes: A bear market phase occurs when the close is at or below 80 percent of the rolling price high
The market phase is executed by the deterministic market phase method and consumed as one market confirmation test
The assistant may explain the method but never change it
records.explanation: The S&P 500 market phase classifies the market as a bull or bear phase against its rolling high. It is one confirmation test within Market Confirmation.

records.label: Credit Conditions Method
records.title: Credit conditions status classification method
method_notes: Credit conditions status is one of the approved ten-state vocabulary
It participates in Market Confirmation as one confirmation test
The assistant may explain the method but never change it
records.explanation: Credit Conditions classifies corporate credit spreads into one of the approved ten states. It is one confirmation test within Market Confirmation.

records.label: Jobless Claims Method
records.title: Jobless claims observation method
method_notes: Jobless claims is an observation-only watch item with no decision effect
It does not participate in any Market Setup decision layer
The assistant may explain the observation method but never change it
records.explanation: Jobless claims is watched as observation evidence only. It never changes a Market Setup decision.

records.label: ISM Manufacturing PMI
records.title: ISM Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index

periods: latest accepted monthly ISM Manufacturing survey

level_contract.wording: A reading above 50 indicates expansion, below 50 indicates contraction, and equal to 50 is neutral

direction_contract.wording: Direction is the month-over-month momentum classified by the approved direction method and is never inferred from the level

method_notes: The PMI level and its direction are separate classification dimensions; a low level does not imply deterioration and a high level does not imply acceleration
The level and direction are classified by the deterministic engine and the assistant must never infer one from the other
records.explanation: The ISM Manufacturing PMI is a monthly diffusion index of manufacturing survey responses. Its level and its direction are separate classifications and must be reported independently.

records.label: S&P 500 Market Phase
records.title: S&P 500 market phase

level_contract.wording: The S&P 500 market phase is bull_market or bear_market relative to a rolling price high

direction_contract.wording: Market phase is a level state; no separate direction classification is defined for this indicator

method_notes: A bear market phase occurs when the close is at or below 80 percent of the rolling price high
The market phase is executed by the deterministic market phase method and consumed as one market confirmation test
records.explanation: The S&P 500 market phase classifies the market as a bull or bear phase against its rolling high. It participates in Market Confirmation as one confirmation test.

records.label: Credit Conditions
records.title: Credit Conditions status

periods: latest accepted corporate credit spread observations

level_contract.wording: Credit conditions status is one of the approved ten-state vocabulary

direction_contract.wording: Credit conditions is a level status classification; no separate direction dimension is defined

method_notes: Credit conditions participates in Market Confirmation as one confirmation test
The approved status vocabulary is consumed from the shared confirmation contract by the deterministic engine
records.explanation: Credit Conditions classifies corporate credit spreads into one of the approved ten states. It is one confirmation test within Market Confirmation.

records.label: VIX
records.title: CBOE Volatility Index

level_contract.threshold_note: 20.0 is the approved v2 confirmation threshold
level_contract.wording: VIX is classified as stress at or above the approved 20.0 threshold and normal below it

direction_contract.wording: VIX confirmation is a level threshold test; no separate direction classification is defined

method_notes: The approved v2 threshold is 20.0 as executed by vix_confirmation_v2
Historical context or an economic rationale for the 20.0 threshold is separate exploration or research unless an approved rationale exists
records.explanation: VIX measures implied volatility and is used as a volatility confirmation test. The approved v2 threshold is 20.0. No economic rationale for the threshold is asserted beyond the approved method.

records.label: M2 Money Supply
records.title: M2 money supply liquidity

periods: latest accepted M2 money stock observation

level_contract.wording: The M2 liquidity offset status is expanding or shock

direction_contract.wording: M2 offset status is a level classification; no separate direction dimension is defined

method_notes: The M2 offset status participates in Market Confirmation as an offset and is not counted in the confirmation test count
The offset status is executed by the deterministic engine
records.explanation: M2 money supply is a liquidity offset that can support a directional confirmation. Its offset status is expanding or shock and it never changes the confirmation test count.

records.label: Jobless Claims
records.title: Jobless claims observation

periods: latest accepted initial and continuing claims observations

level_contract.wording: Jobless claims is an observation-only watch item with no approved level classification

direction_contract.wording: Jobless claims is an observation-only watch item with no approved direction classification

method_notes: Jobless claims is an observation-only watch item with no decision effect
It does not participate in any Market Setup decision layer
records.explanation: Jobless claims is watched as observation evidence only. It never changes a Market Setup decision.

records.label: Equity Breadth
records.title: Equity breadth observation

level_contract.wording: Equity breadth is an observation-only watch item with no approved level classification

direction_contract.wording: Equity breadth is an observation-only watch item with no approved direction classification

method_notes: Equity breadth is an observation-only watch item with no decision effect
It does not participate in any Market Setup decision layer
No accepted local equity breadth data source is configured in v1
records.explanation: Equity breadth is watched as observation evidence only. It never changes a Market Setup decision.

records.label: ISM Surveys
records.title: ISM Manufacturing and Services survey sources

periods: official ISM monthly survey releases accepted by the dashboard

method_notes: The dashboard consumes normalized ISM Manufacturing and Services survey signals from official ISM report data
records.explanation: ISM survey data is the accepted local source for the survey signals consumed by the dashboard.

records.label: S&P 500 Price Source
records.title: S&P 500 benchmark price source

periods: accepted S&P 500 price history used by the dashboard

method_notes: S&P 500 price history is persisted from the accepted benchmark price workbook and consumed as the market phase input
records.explanation: The dashboard's S&P 500 market phase is computed from accepted benchmark price data.

records.label: Credit Conditions Source
records.title: Corporate credit spread source

periods: P05 workbook history merged with FRED ICE/BofA observations

method_notes: Credit spread history is merged from the P05 workbook with the latest FRED ICE/BofA observations
Missing dates are shown as a data gap and are not interpolated
records.explanation: Corporate credit spread data is the accepted local source for the credit conditions status.

records.label: VIX Source
records.title: CBOE VIX source

periods: FRED VIXCLS observations accepted by the dashboard

method_notes: The dashboard's accepted VIX level comes from the FRED VIXCLS series
The underlying indicator is the CBOE Volatility Index (VIX)
records.explanation: The VIX level consumed by the dashboard comes from the FRED VIXCLS series for the CBOE VIX index.

records.label: M2 Money Supply Source
records.title: M2 money stock source

periods: nominal M2 monthly workbook observations accepted by the dashboard

method_notes: The dashboard's M2 money stock is imported from the approved monthly workbook
records.explanation: Nominal M2 money stock is the accepted local source for the M2 liquidity offset.

records.label: Jobless Claims Source
records.title: Department of Labor UI claims source

periods: latest accepted initial and continuing claims observations

method_notes: Weekly UI claims are fetched from the Department of Labor UI claims source
records.explanation: Weekly UI claims are the accepted local source for the jobless claims observation item.
